teaser: One week you have booked a flight nobody asked you to book. The next you have talked yourself out of it mid-boarding-pass. That is the texture of life path 5 crossed with an ENTP: the number is built on movement, the letters are built on possibility, and you can start a conversation, a company, or a country three times before lunch. The pairing is particular because neither side slows the other. Restlessness meets curiosity and neither asks the other to sit still. What gets lost is quieter than what gets gained, and worth noticing.
excerpt: The chair with the one short leg in the vet clinic waiting room rocks whenever either of you shifts, and it is in that half-irritated quiet that a partner finally says the thing: it is hard to make plans with someone…
